title: Law to publish a live map of snow plow locations
summary: This bill would require the Department of Sanitation to equip all snow plows with GPS and publish a public website showing current and historical snow plowing data. The map would update at least every 15 minutes during storms, let users filter by date, storm, borough, district and route priority, and show overlays for schools, hospitals and other critical sites. Agencies must post the map by October 31, 2027 and make underlying data available for bulk download.
